headline: ibyyue slips out of ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: ibyyue dropped from 14th to 17th on the public ARC-2 board, with its score unchanged at 65.56.
The 16th-place gold line rose to 65.97, leaving ibyyue 0.41 short of the final gold place.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
